en: A popular style of clothes, hair or behavior at a particular time; or a way of doing something.
ex: Long skirts are in fashion this year.
今年流行長裙。

en: The power that is believed to control what happens in life; or what will happen to someone.
ex: Fate brought the two friends together again.
命運讓這兩位朋友再次相聚。

en: A mistake that you are responsible for; or a problem in a machine; or to find mistakes in something.
ex: It was my fault that we missed the bus.
我們錯過公車是我的錯。

en: A kind act that you do for someone; or to prefer something; or support for an idea.
ex: Could you do me a favor and watch my bag?
你可以幫我看一下我的包包嗎？

en: Liked more than all others of the same kind; or a person or thing that you like best.
ex: Chocolate is my favorite kind of ice cream.
巧克力是我最愛的冰淇淋口味。

en: A strong unpleasant feeling when you are in danger or think something bad will happen; or to be afraid of something.
ex: She has a great fear of spiders.
她非常怕蜘蛛。

en: An important or interesting part of something; or a part of the face; or a special article in a newspaper.
ex: The new phone has several useful features.
這支新手機有好幾項實用的功能。

en: A sum of money that you pay for a service or to enter somewhere.
ex: There is a small fee to enter the museum.
進博物館需要付少許費用。

en: An emotion such as happiness or anger; or the ability to feel something physical; or an opinion.
ex: She had a happy feeling when she saw her old friends.
她見到老朋友時心裡很高興。

en: A man or boy; or a person with the same job or interest as you; or a member of a group.
ex: He is a nice fellow who is always ready to help.
他是個隨時樂於助人的好人。

en: A woman or girl; or an animal that can lay eggs or give birth to babies; or relating to women.
ex: The class has ten male students and twelve female students.
班上有十位男學生和十二位女學生。

en: A condition in which your body temperature is higher than normal because you are ill; or a state of great excitement.
ex: She stayed in bed because she had a high fever.
她因為發高燒而臥床休息。

en: A piece of land used for growing crops or keeping animals; or a flat area used for sports; or a subject area.
ex: The children are playing football in the field.
孩子們在場地上踢足球。

en: A number; or the shape of a person's body; or an important person; or to think or decide.
ex: The sales figures for this year are very high.
今年的銷售數字非常高。

en: A person whose job is to put out fires.
ex: The fireman rescued a cat from the tree.
消防員從樹上救下了一隻貓。

en: A business or company; or hard and solid; or not likely to change.
ex: She works at a firm that makes software.
她在一家製作軟體的公司工作。

en: A person who catches fish, either as a job or for pleasure.
ex: The fisherman caught a big fish early in the morning.
漁夫清晨釣到了一條大魚。

en: To be the right size and shape for someone or something; or healthy and strong; or to put something into a place.
ex: These shoes fit me perfectly.
這雙鞋我穿剛剛好。

en: To repair something that is broken; or to arrange something; or to fasten something firmly in place.
ex: My father fixed my bicycle in ten minutes.
我爸爸十分鐘就修好了我的腳踏車。

en: Smooth and level, with no raised or lower parts; or an apartment; or (of a tire) without enough air.
ex: The country is flat, with few hills or mountains.
這個國家地勢平坦，很少有山丘。

en: A journey in an aircraft; or the act of flying; or a set of stairs between floors.
ex: The flight from Taipei to Tokyo takes about three hours.
從台北到東京的航程大約要三小時。

en: To move continuously in one direction like water; or a continuous movement of liquid or air; or to move smoothly.
ex: The river flows through the center of the city.
這條河流過市中心。

en: A common illness like a bad cold, with fever and aches, that spreads easily.
col: a bad case of the flu
ex: Half of my classmates are absent because of the flu.
我一半的同學因為流感而缺席。

en: The center of interest or activity; or to give all your attention to something; or the point where light rays meet.
ex: Please focus on your work and stop talking.
請專心做你的事，不要講話。

en: A thick cloud of tiny drops of water near the ground that makes it hard to see.
ex: The ship could not sail because of the thick fog.
由於濃霧，船無法啟航。

en: People in general; or members of your family; or relating to traditional music or art of ordinary people.
ex: She enjoys listening to folk music on weekends.
她週末喜歡聽民謠。

en: Coming after in time or order; or the things that are about to be mentioned; or a group of people who follow someone.
ex: Please answer the following questions.
請回答下列問題。

en: Not showing good sense or judgment; or silly.
ex: It was foolish of him to forget his homework.
他忘了帶功課，真是愚蠢。

en: A game played by two teams of eleven players who kick a ball and try to score goals; (American) a similar game played with an oval ball.
ex: The boys are playing football in the park.
男孩們在公園踢足球。

en: Physical strength or power; or to make someone do something; or a group of soldiers or police.
ex: The thieves forced the door open.
小偷們強行撬開了門。

en: A large area of land covered with trees.
ex: We camped in a quiet forest near the river.
我們在河邊一片安靜的森林裡露營。

en: To stop being angry with someone who has done something wrong.
ex: Please forgive me for being late.
請原諒我遲到了。

en: A type of something; or a paper with spaces to write information; or to make or become a particular shape.
ex: Please fill in this form with your name and address.
請在這張表格上填寫你的姓名和地址。

en: Following the proper rules or customs; or suitable for serious occasions; or official.
ex: You must wear formal clothes to the dinner.
你必須穿正式服裝去參加晚宴。

en: Having been something in the past; or the first of two things mentioned.
ex: The former mayor now teaches at a university.
前任市長現在在大學任教。

en: Toward the front or forward; or out from a place; or from a particular time onward.
ex: From that day forth, they became good friends.
從那天起，他們成了好朋友。

en: Toward the front or the future; or moving ahead; or to send a letter to another address.
ex: I look forward to seeing you again next week.
我期待下週再見到你。

en: Toward the front or forward; or advancing or in the direction you are facing.
ex: Lean forwards and put your hands on the desk.
身體往前傾，把手放在桌上。

en: To start something such as an organization or school; or the past tense of 'find'.
ex: The school was founded in 1900.
這所學校創立於1900年。

en: A wild animal like a small dog with red-brown fur and a thick tail; or a clever, cunning person.
ex: The fox crept quietly toward the chicken coop.
狐狸悄悄地爬向雞舍。
